ValidationRule.description: Reinforces that SOW Delivered must remain TRUE for any Stage past Propose (Negotiate, Hold, Commit, Closed Won). Complements the earlier-stage VRs that gate entry into Propose and Negotiate.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Negotiate"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Hold"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Commit"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won") ), SOW_Delivered__c = FALSE )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To move past 'Propose', please ensure SOW Delivered is checked.
